# Vidogi Salon (concept by Kerblabs)
> Hair salon at 4228 N Brown Ave, Scottsdale, AZ 85251. Source: vidogisalon.com.

## Services
Hair color, ombre and balayage, vivid colors, Olaplex, hair cut and style, extensions (sewn-in, weft, tape-in, I-tip), texture (keratin, relaxer, permanent straightening), makeup, bridal (on location or in salon), facials, massages.

## Hours
Mon-Sat 10:00-19:00, Sun 12:00-17:00.

## Actions
- Book: call (480) 947-3720 or use online scheduling at https://www.vidogisalon.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vidogisalon
